sources.label: Ad, tracking, splash-ad and forced-update-lockout patches for the ESPNcricinfo A
sources.author: ESPNcricinfo Ad & Tracking Removal
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, comScore, Conviva and Adobe Marketing from initializing, so they collect or send no attribution/analytics data. Leaves CleverTap intact to preserve push notifications.

Stops ESPNcricinfo from fetching or showing banner, interstitial, native, rewarded and app-open ads (Google Ad Manager, Meta Audience Network, Taboola) by severing the Flutter ad plugins and skipping the ad SDK setup.
Remove splash ad, startup delay & forced update
